translations.idiomatic: Boyan restored the long canal for ten li, routing it around Maple Tree Dam and reinforcing it with stone; the watercourse fully recovered Bian's original layout, the fields yielded reliably again, and the people prospered from it.

sentences.zh: 安慶路嘗得造偽鈔者，遣卒械其囚至崇安，求其黨而執之，囚與卒結謀，望風入良民家肆虐。

translations.literal: Anqing Circuit once captured counterfeiters and sent soldiers to escort the prisoner in fetters to Chong'an to seize his accomplices; the prisoner and soldiers plotted, and at the first opportunity they entered innocent people's homes and committed outrages.
translations.idiomatic: Anqing Circuit once captured counterfeiters and sent soldiers to escort a prisoner in fetters to Chong'an to round up accomplices; the prisoner and soldiers conspired and, seizing their chance, rampaged through innocent households.

sentences.zh: 伯顏捕訊得其狀，即執而歸諸安慶，自是偽造之連逮無濫及崇安者。

translations.literal: Boyan arrested and interrogated them, obtained the facts, immediately seized them and sent them back to Anqing; from then on those implicated in counterfeiting did not extend indiscriminately to Chong'an.
translations.idiomatic: Boyan investigated, learned the truth, arrested them, and sent them back to Anqing; thereafter counterfeiting cases no longer swept up innocent people in Chong'an.

sentences.zh: 於是行省帥府、御史憲府咸舉其能。

translations.literal: Thereupon the branch secretariat, marshal's headquarters, and surveillance commission all recommended his competence.
translations.idiomatic: The branch secretariat, marshal's headquarters, and surveillance commission all recommended him for his ability.

sentences.zh: 選調漳州路判官。

translations.literal: He was selected and transferred to be assistant prefect of Zhangzhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was selected and appointed assistant prefect of Zhangzhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 劉秉直，字清臣，大都武清人。

translations.literal: Liu Bingzhi, style name Qingchen, was a man of Wuqing in Dadu.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Bingzhi, courtesy name Qingchen, was a native of Wuqing in Dadu.

sentences.zh: 至正八年，來為衛輝路總管​​，平徭役，興教化，敦四民之業，崇五土之利，養鰥寡，恤孤獨。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhizheng he came to serve as circuit intendant of Weihui, equalized corvée, promoted moral education, encouraged the four classes in their occupations, honored the advantages of the five grains, supported widows and widowers, and comforted the orphaned and alone.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Zhizheng (1348) he became circuit intendant of Weihui, where he equalized corvée, promoted education, encouraged the four classes in their trades, honored agriculture, and cared for widows, orphans, and the destitute.

sentences.zh: 賊劫汲縣民張聚鈔一千二百錠而殺之，賊不獲，秉直具詞致禱城隍祠，而使人伺於死所，忽有村民阿蓮者，戰怖僕地，具言賊之姓名及所在，乃命尉襲之，果得賊於汴，遂正其罪。

translations.literal: Bandits robbed and killed a man of Ji County named Zhang Ju of twelve hundred ingots of paper money; the bandits were not captured; Bingzhi composed a petition and prayed at the City God shrine, then had men watch at the place of death; suddenly a villager named Alian, trembling with terror, collapsed and fully stated the bandits' names and whereabouts; he then ordered the bailiff to raid them and indeed seized the bandits in Bian, and their crime was duly punished.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits robbed and murdered Zhang Ju of Ji County for twelve hundred ingots of paper money, but could not be found; Bingzhi prayed at the City God shrine and posted men at the scene; a villager named Alian, shaking with fear, fell to the ground and named the culprits and where they hid; Bingzhi sent the bailiff after them, captured them in Bian, and punished them according to law.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，蟲螟生，民患之，秉直禱於八蜡祠，蟲皆自死。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn locusts and caterpillars appeared and the people suffered; Bingzhi prayed at the Eight Sacrifices shrine and the insects all died of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month caterpillars and locusts appeared and plagued the people; Bingzhi prayed at the Eight Sacrifices shrine, and the pests died off.

sentences.zh: 歲大饑，人相食，死者過半，秉直出俸米，倡富民分粟，餒者食之，病者與藥，死者與棺以葬。

translations.literal: That year there was great famine and people ate one another; more than half died; Bingzhi gave out his salary grain, urged wealthy households to share grain, fed the starving, gave medicine to the sick, and coffins for burial to the dead.
translations.idiomatic: Famine struck that year; people ate the dead and more than half perished; Bingzhi distributed his salary grain, urged the wealthy to share their stores, fed the hungry, gave medicine to the sick, and coffins to bury the dead.

sentences.zh: 天不雨，禾且槁，秉直詣城北太行之蒼峪神祠，具詞祈祝，有青蛇蜿蜒而出，觀者異之。

translations.literal: Heaven sent no rain and the grain was about to wither; Bingzhi went to the Cangyu God shrine in the northern Taihang outside the city, composed a petition and prayed; a green snake wriggled out, and onlookers marveled.
translations.idiomatic: When drought threatened the crops, Bingzhi went to the Cangyu God shrine in the Taihang foothills north of the city and prayed; a green snake emerged and wound its way forth, to the wonder of all who saw it.

sentences.zh: 辭神而還，行及數里，雷雨大至。

translations.literal: When he took leave of the god and returned, he had gone only several li when great thunder and rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: As he left the shrine and headed back, he had gone only a few li when thunder and heavy rain burst forth.

sentences.zh: 秩滿，以親老，去官侍養。

translations.literal: When his term expired, because his parents were old, he left office to serve them at home.
translations.idiomatic: When his term ended, his parents being elderly, he resigned to care for them at home.

sentences.zh: 許義夫，碭山人。

translations.literal: Xu Yifu was a man of Dangshan.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Yifu was a native of Dangshan.

sentences.zh: 為夏邑縣尹，每親詣鄉社，教民稼穡。

translations.literal: As magistrate of Xiayi County he personally visited village altars to teach the people farming.
translations.idiomatic: As magistrate of Xiayi County he personally visited village altars to teach the people how to farm.

sentences.zh: 見民勤謹者，出己俸賞之，怠惰者罰之。

translations.literal: When he saw people diligent and careful he rewarded them from his own salary; the lazy he punished.
translations.idiomatic: He rewarded the diligent from his own salary and punished the idle.

sentences.zh: 三年之間，境內豐足。

translations.literal: Within three years the district was plentiful.
translations.idiomatic: Within three years the district was prosperous and well supplied.

sentences.zh: 後為封丘縣尹，值至正四年大饑，盜賊群起，抄掠州縣。

translations.literal: Later as magistrate of Fengqiu County, in the fourth year of Zhizheng there was great famine and bandits rose in groups, looting prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Later, as magistrate of Fengqiu County, in the fourth year of Zhizheng (1344) famine struck and bandits rose in bands, looting prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 義夫聞賊至近境，乃單馬出郊十里外迎之，見賊數百人，義夫力言：「封丘縣小民貧，皆已驚惶逃竄，幸無入吾境也。」

translations.literal: When Yifu heard the bandits were nearing his border, he went out alone on horseback ten li beyond the suburbs to meet them; seeing several hundred bandits, he spoke forcefully: "Fengqiu is a small county and the people are poor; they have all fled in panic—please do not enter our territory."
translations.idiomatic: When Yifu heard bandits were nearing his border, he rode out alone ten li beyond the town to meet them; facing several hundred men, he pleaded earnestly: "Fengqiu is small and poor; the people have all fled in terror—please do not enter our district."

sentences.zh: 言辭愿款，賊遂他往。

translations.literal: His words were sincere and earnest, and the bandits went elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: His words were sincere and moving, and the bandits went elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 封丘之民，得免於難。

translations.literal: The people of Fengqiu were thereby spared calamity.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Fengqiu were spared the disaster.
